name: window-backdrop-veil
note: GLASS-SKYCATCH-VEIL (v0.31.8.50) — WINDOW-LUMINANCE (l). Stands the walker at the default 4-room flat's living/dining window (10.9, 3.4) looking north at the 2.45 m opening, and shoots the same framing across all four painted backdrops. The pane's emissive sky-catch retires whenever a backdrop is painted, so these frames are where that shows: measure the pane rectangle (left 395, top 340, 740x480) — sd and p95-p05 spread rise 19-40% against the veiled build. The pose is set through the dev-only window.__walkLook lever (setPosition/setYaw/setPitch), because Pointer Lock is unavailable headless so neither WASD nor mouse-look works. The orbit half is deliberately NOT shot here: the walk->orbit return holds a "Switching to overview..." splash for longer than any settle this harness will wait (reproduced on the SHIPPED backdrop-walk-simple scenario, whose own final orbit frame is that splash), so the frame would prove nothing. That the orbit path is unchanged is proven by construction instead — it passes backdropVisibleNow() === false, and glassSkyCatchIntensity(x, false) === glassSkyCatchIntensity(x) is a test.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: aim-at-window
steps.eval: (() => { const L = window.__walkLook; if (!L) throw new Error('window.__walkLook missing — the dev-only camera lever is what makes this scenario possible'); L.setPosition(10.9, 3.4); L.setYaw(0); L.setPitch(0) })()

steps.name: reaim-city

steps.name: assert-skycatch-retired
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.cameraMode !== 'firstPerson') throw new Error('expected walk mode'); if (s.backdrop !== 'dusk') throw new Error('expected the dusk backdrop'); })()
